about: uMed photo heads (v0.46): a lesion-type gate (rash / lesion / other / none), the SCIN rash head and a pigmented-lesion head, all logistic on MobileNetV2 (ONNX model zoo, Apache-2.0, 8-bit) pooled features with the scaler folded in. Trained on SCIN (Google/Stanford, SCIN Data Use License) and ISIC Archive clinical photos (PAD-UFES-20, MSKCC, Hospital Italiano; CC-BY / CC-0) train splits only; see docs/v046_photo_dx.md. Escalate-only: it can add causes and ask a picture card first, and a clear melanoma look sets a 48-72 hour floor; it never lowers urgency and never calls a mole benign.
